title: The Mass Gap Approach to QCD. II. The non-perturbative renormalization theory for the massive gluon fields
summary: The previously formulated the mass gap approach to QCD, based on a new insights into its ground state(vacuum), makes it possible to exactly define the dynamically generated gluon pole mass. We developed a non-perturbative multiplicative renormalization program for the corresponding massive full gluon propagator. Its asymptotic properties have been analyzed, including the perturbation theory limit to the free gluon state, i.e., no asymptotic freedom effect.
